draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.80, the 207th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 29th of 37 at CB. He went 200th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (90th percentile), vertical jump (98th percentile), broad jump (98th percentile). College production: 2 passes defended in 2020, 26th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Pittsburgh Steelers. 73 career games and 22 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 2 AV in 2025 against a career-best 4 in 2021. Strengths in 2025: interceptions 2 (82nd percentile). Weak spots: missed tackle rate 15.8% (15th percentile), completion % allowed 70.0% (17th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 cornerback who played: 44.9% season snap share against a median of 33.5%, above the norm.
